help.description: Crack the secret colour code before you run out of guesses.
help.step1: Tap colours to fill the empty row.
help.stepRemove: Tap a colour in the row to take it out.
help.step2: Press Check to try your guess.
help.step3: Each black peg is a bull: right colour, right spot.
help.step4: Each white peg is a cow: right colour, wrong spot.
help.step5: The black and white pegs don't say which spot they mean. That's the puzzle!
help.step6: Crack the code before you run out of rows.
